rav.text: Jarad vod Savo is opposed to his twin Savra and allies with Agrus Kos and Fonn Zunich to upset Szadek's coup at the Decamillennial Festival, and after Savra dies he takes control of the Golgari Swarm.
He briefly marries Fonn and fathers Myc, and Izolda kills him in a Rakdos ritual as he tries to rescue Myc, but he possesses his own corpse and becomes a lich.
The Cilia isolate Jarad, and when Nicol Bolas tells Vraska where he is, she finds him, Storrev betrays him, Xeddick extracts his secrets, and Vraska petrifies him.

dis.text: At the Decamillennial in Dissension, Jarad seizes Savra's staff and turns Szadek's Lupul against him, and afterward he becomes Golgari guildmaster.
Lyzolda uses Myc's blood to raise Rakdos, but Jarad's intervention disrupts the ritual and links Myc's mind to the demon, and she then kills Jarad and uses his blood to complete it.
Jarad returns as a lich, and Fonn brings Myc to him as a zombie, where Myc decides to become a Golgari hunter.
